identity.title: Runtime: eliminate hosted Guardian executable spawn flake

values.goal: Eliminate the deterministic hosted Runtime CI cause that makes valid Guardian test children intermittently surface as SpawnFailed.
values.required_outcome: The two observed Guardian regressions and the full required Runtime lane resolve child executables independently of test order and caller cwd while genuine missing programs remain fail-closed.
authority_boundary: Production Guardian spawn errors remain fail-closed
Issue #252 owns only executable resolution/invocation at the Guardian fixture boundary
operator_constraints: Use repository or Git-common paths and never /private/tmp
Run no optional or paid CI
Do not merge without explicit authorization
